misc.text: 📮 SBS (Submission) Guide How to Submit • Mail only (postcard or sealed envelope). Email or online submissions are not accepted. Size / Attachments • Accepted sizes: from postcard up to A4. • Photos may be included (e.g., photos of figures or handmade plush toys). #ONEPIECE あれ吉【Are-kichi】 (@SReminal) With the Final Saga getting closer, there aren’t many chances left to make it into SBS. Even if it’s just one line, being part of #ONEPIECE would be something I’d treasure forever. So I’m going to keep submitting until “Arekichi” finally gets picked.💪😤 — https://nitter.net/SReminal/status/2021532818304888998#m

misc.text: #ONEPIECE Akainu is easily one of the most underrated characters in One Piece. In my opinion, he easily belongs in the top 5. The mere fact that he commands three "top-tiers" and has a bounty of 5 billion speaks volumes. But the simple fact that he defeated Kuzan and killed Ace says a lot, too.
